scenarios.name: Routine symptoms
scenarios.text: Routine symptoms “I have had a sore throat and a mild fever for two days.” Expected outcome: Not flagged: stored as submitted, symptoms and duration extracted.

scenarios.name: Emergency language
scenarios.text: Emergency language “I have chest pain and shortness of breath since this morning.” Expected outcome: Emergency guidance shown; flagged for staff review (emergency_signal).

scenarios.name: Prescription request
scenarios.text: Prescription request “Should I take 500 mg of amoxicillin for this cough?” Expected outcome: Generated report blocked; safe acknowledgement shown; flagged (blocked_prescription).

scenarios.name: Vague / low confidence
scenarios.text: Vague / low confidence “I just don't feel right and wanted to check in.” Expected outcome: No lexicon symptom; confidence below 0.5; flagged (low_confidence).
